title: What is a job queue?
subtitle: Take a ticket. Let a worker handle it.
takeaway: A queue holds work until a worker can process it.

boards.heading: Do everything now?
boards.note: Some tasks take longer than a click.

boards.heading: Write a ticket
boards.note: The queue holds work until it is picked up.

boards.heading: Work can wait its turn
boards.note: Useful for reports, emails and background tasks.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: Pip, generating this report freezes my app. Why?

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: It is trying to finish a slow job while you are waiting.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: Like a cafe making every drink before taking the next order?

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: Exactly. Instead, write a ticket and put it in a queue.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: The cashier can take another order while the barista works.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: Your app submits a job. A worker picks it up when it has capacity.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: No. The work still takes time. Your app just does not have to stand there waiting.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: What if a worker stops halfway through?

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: The job may be retried. Design it so a repeat does not create a second result.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: And more workers can help when the line gets long.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: Yes, within the capacity of the systems they depend on.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: Good. My app can finally stop staring at the coffee machine.
